errors.text_span: но еталоните за числото на докладите (лева) са включени
errors.evidence: This phrase incorrectly and ambiguously describes the labels. The units are "доклада" (reports) for the left chart and "млрд. лв." (billion BGN) for the right chart, not just "(лева)". The phrase "еталоните за числото на докладите" (benchmarks for the number of reports) is also an inaccurate way to describe the absolute values shown.
The figure does not have a separate legend. It uses direct labels with pointers to identify the slices in each pie chart.
The phrase "but it is very simplified" is a subjective judgment, which goes against the prompt's instruction to avoid interpretation.

The description notes the descending order of the slices for the left chart but omits mentioning that the slices in the right chart are also ordered by descending size (Failures > Unclassified > Successes).
